name: Gold Coast
tagline: Surf beaches, theme parks and rainforest hinterland
summary: The Gold Coast is Australia's playground: 50 km of surf beaches backed by high-rises, with theme parks inland and ancient rainforest in the hinterland. Surf or swim at Burleigh Heads, ride to the top of SkyPoint, meet koalas at Currumbin and see glow-worms at Springbrook's Natural Bridge.
seasonNote: Winter (June to August) is sunny and mild; summer is hot, humid and busy with school holidays.
arrival: Gold Coast Airport (Coolangatta) is 25 minutes from Burleigh; Brisbane Airport is about 75 minutes by train.
gettingAround: The G:link tram runs along the coast; a car helps for the hinterland.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; cash is rarely needed.
foodTip: Fish and chips on the beach, Miami Marketta street food and Broadbeach dining.
baseArea: Burleigh Heads, Broadbeach or Surfers Paradise

connections.note: Tram plus train, or an hour's drive.
